utils.session module¶

Shared session state management — extracted from app.py.

utils.session.clear_data() → None[source]¶

Wipe all analysis session state. Does not touch auth/GA4 credentials.

Called from: sidebar.py (Clear Data button), sidebar.py (GA4 disconnect), and sidebar.py (file processing — new file replaces old data).
